summary: Two out-of-state hikers spent the night on Mount Princeton after deviating from the trail above Agnes Vaille Falls; the first 911 call came the night of July 4, and the search team found them the next morning
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office / Chaffee County SAR
notes: Run 191: recorded at search-conclusion date 2012-07-05 (Thursday, weekday-verified) — first 911 call the night of July 4, team searched, halted overnight, and found the hikers the morning of July 5. Source (Mountain Mail "Chaffee County Search and Rescue" feature, published ~July 5-6, 2012; interview with Undersheriff John Spezze on July 5) gives no names and reports no injuries. Dedupe: no Chaffee rows 2012-07-01-10, no Princeton/Agnes Vaille collisions (only id 193 is a different 2013 rockslide). Paraphrased, incident-focused.
